shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -120

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "imgUrl\|text?\|size?\|fallbackImgUrl" $U/Avatar/types.d.ts | head; echo ---SELECT; grep -n "options?\|onUpdate\|value?\|placeholder\|width?\|filterable\|renderOption\|disablePortal\|label?" $U/Select/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---SWITCH; cat $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ---CHECKBOX; cat $U/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked\|content\|title" $U/types.d.ts | head; echo ---TEXTINPUT; grep -n "onUpdate\|value?\|size?\|errorMessage\|validationState\|hasClear\|label?" $U/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---FLEX; grep -n "direction\|gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo ---TEXT; grep -n "variant\|color" $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "'body\|'header\|'subheader\|'display\|'caption" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20; echo ---BUTTON; grep -n "view?\|size?\|width?\|loading" $U/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo ---USERLABEL; ls $U/User; echo ---TOASTER; ls $U/Toaster

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls $U/Avatar && cat $U/Avatar/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---TEXTVARIANTS; grep -rn "header-\|subheader-\|body-\|caption-" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; echo ---SPACE; grep -n "Space" $U/layout/types.d.ts | head -3; echo ---TOASTER-API; grep -n "add\|ToasterProvider\|useToaster" $U/Toaster/index.d.ts $U/Toaster/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---LABEL; grep -n "theme?" $U/Label/Label.d.ts; echo ---FORMROW; ls $U/legacy; echo ---ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat $U/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts $U/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; echo ---ALERT; grep -n "theme?\|title?\|message?\|onClose?\|layout?\|view?" $U/Alert/types.d.ts | head; echo ---LAYOUT; ls $U/layout; echo ---EXPORTS; grep -n "Avatar\|Alert\|Flex\|Box\|Divider\|Card\|Text'" $U/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ---CARD; grep -n "view?\|type?\|theme?" $U/Card/Card.d.ts

sed -i "s|^import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';|import type React from 'react';\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';|" src/ProfileSettings.tsx && head -3 src/ProfileSettings.tsx && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i playwright; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "browser-check-done"
